capabilities: Create and open a game index listing every campaign in the vault
Generate campaign folders and one campaign index note per campaign
Create next-numbered session notes with a recap of the previous session
Render sortable, filterable live tables via dragon-glass code blocks
Tabulate arbitrary notes by frontmatter type with inferred columns
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README explains design limits, such as why the campaign type is a single fixed value.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for tabletop RPG campaigns, so players typically assemble one from Dataview, Templater and button plugins.

relations.evidence: no dependency on Dataview, Templater, Meta Bind, or Buttons
